feature: Local Passenger A/B, Driver and demonstration dashboard served by Gateway

application_handler_e2e.method: Actual app.js event handlers and real Gateway HTTP requests, using a minimal DOM fixture rather than an automated browser
cases: Create demo accounts, login, update Driver location and availability, quote and book a trip
Reauthenticate the same passenger without losing the active trip
Accept and start a trip, stop Payment, complete the real trip and observe COMPLETED
Restart Payment and observe the same trip PAID with SUCCESS payment
Dispatch two passenger requests concurrently and observe exclusive driver assignment
Cancel trips and observe Driver AVAILABLE
Simulate a lost HTTP response after real booking commit, block duplicate booking, reconcile with Trip ID
Mark stale Driver state independently of successful Trip polling

integration: Reviewed source files copied from isolated worktree after original-file baseline checks and byte-for-byte hash validation; no commit or push
